subtitle: A Sonoma County sea-stack beach where Goat Rock was dynamited for jetty fill in 1929, and where swimmers drowned for decades before a lifeguard tower arrived.
spike_statement: Sonoma County's second-most-popular beach got its first lifeguard tower only in May 2018, after a father and his 6-year-old son drowned there in December 2017.

levers.photo_tone: Cold gray sea-stack silhouette and white spray against fog, the isthmus barely holding Goat Rock to shore.
